module: Console test script for dynamic collisions: deletes all objects, spawns a pickup at (0, 0, 0.1) then runs test(5000), i.e. 5001 steps of BeamEngine:update(1/2000, 1/2000). The additional spawns (hatch, second pickup) are commented out.
notes: Defines the global v. The timing in test() is commented out (and contains a mistake: hp:stop().-" ms").

test.desc: Runs n+1 simulation steps of 0.5 ms (BeamEngine:update(1/2000, 1/2000)).

n.desc: Number of steps (loop from 0 to n inclusive).
